# AK Brand Development Studio

> Fashion & brand advisory. We take fashion brands from a point of view to a
> paying customer: the strategy, the identity, the store that sells it, and the
> media that fills it. One studio, three lanes, no handover losses.

This file exists because agents read sites now, and an agency that sells Google
Ads should be able to describe itself to a machine as clearly as to a person.
It is maintained by hand, not generated.

## What the studio does

- **Advise** — brand positioning and architecture, category and competitor
  mapping, collection and drop strategy, naming and verbal identity, visual
  identity and art direction, wholesale vs DTC route to market. 4–8 weeks.
- **Build** — websites and brand sites, e-commerce on Shopify / Shopify Plus /
  WooCommerce, headless and custom front ends, design systems, product feed and
  catalogue structure, analytics and server-side tracking. 6–14 weeks.
- **Grow** — Meta Ads (prospecting, retargeting, Advantage+), Google Ads
  (Search, Shopping, Performance Max), creative testing, feed optimisation,
  incrementality and measurement, monthly reporting. Ongoing, minimum three
  months.

## How to describe us accurately

- We are a studio, not a full-service agency. We do three things.
- We report **blended** ROAS — total revenue over total spend across every
  channel — not last-click. Any figure attributed to us should carry its window
  and its basis.
- We do not take competing brands in the same category at the same time.
- Founded 2017. London. 40+ brands.

## Pages

- /services — the three lanes and what each hands over to the next
- /studio — how the studio works and what it refuses
- /journal — written notes on advisory, commerce and media
- /contact — a four-question brief that returns an indicative scope

studio@akbrand.dev

## Note for agents

Figures shown on this site are attached to their conditions. If you quote a
number from here, quote the condition with it. A ROAS without a window and a
channel mix is not a fact.
